capabilities: Annotate selected Markdown text with change instructions
Queue annotations in current.json for agent consumption
Toggle Review mode to hide or show annotation cards and highlights
Jump to and manage pending annotations from a side pane
Install a Skill that lets Claude Code or Cursor process the queue
disambiguation: Not an AI agent itself; it only queues instructions for an external agent (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) to apply.
extras: Agent-side Skill must be installed separately into the agent's skills directory; the README also points to a product requirements doc (docs/PRD.md, in Chinese). Manifest notes the plugin is not reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: There is no built-in way to mark passages in a note with edit instructions that an AI agent can later read and execute.

relations.evidence: Copy skill/obsidian-agent-annotations/ into the Agent's skills directory

requires.name: AI agent such as Claude Code or Cursor

summary: Annotation plugin that turns selected Markdown passages into change instructions queued in current.json for external AI agents to apply.
